Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and infra teams want a technical deep-dive focused on multi-region deployment and data residency controls (EU/US/APAC). They asked for an architecture review session with the following goals:

- Confirm data residency model for user data and KV/cache behavior across regions
- Discuss smart routing and failover between EU/US/APAC clusters
- Review KMS/HSM integration options and audit logging retention
- Surface any PII/data transfer considerations and mitigation approaches

Would Redwood be available for a 60–90 minute session the week of Mar 15? Prefer EU-friendly times (their lead is in Berlin). I’ve attached our questionnaire and a brief list of compliance questions.

Proposed slots (all CET):
- Mon Mar 15, 10:00–11:30 CET
- Tue Mar 16, 14:00–15:30 CET
- Wed Mar 17, 08:00–09:30 CET (APAC-friendly)

If possible, include a solutions architect and someone who can speak to Dedicated/Private deployment options.

Thanks —
Sofia
